name: Monica Kodwani
role: PhD student in usable security and privacy
shortBio: I am a PhD student in usable security and privacy at The George Washington University. I build human-centered tools and methods for evaluating, auditing, and governing generative AI systems in real-world use, with a focus on privacy reflection, transparency, and accountability.
